description: Four units whose lossless frame has the DTS:X word after its band data and a navigation index whose CRC-16 fails, so the word is not looked for.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder checks the navigation index CRC-16 before it looks for the DTS:X word (dca_xll.c: 'Invalid NAVI checksum')
